index.html.title: State-of-the-Art Multimedia Studio & Production Suite
index.html.body: Equipped with professional broadcast microphones, acoustic wood paneling, bi-directional recording zones, and 4K video recording equipment. Designed to support faculty open courseware, student podcasting, academic dissertations, and digital scholarship.

media.caption: Multimedia Studio Broadcast Suite, Ground Floor, Main Library

services.html.title: Makerspace & Creative Innovation Lab
services.html.body: A dynamic collaborative space on the 1st Floor fostering design thinking, hardware prototyping, and interdisciplinary problem solving. Features collaborative circular seating, interactive smart boards, and presentation facilities.
